children: Xiaomi's memory and other chip inventories could help defend against margin pressure, although this drains working capital, Jefferies analysts write in a note. The company has been aggressively building memory and other chip inventories to avoid further price hikes, they say. Xiaomi's smartphone revenue fell only 1%, better than feared, they add. The company's management believes the Dynamic Random-Access Memory prices will continue to rise and NAND chip prices will be flattish. Since DRAM is a bigger cost item than NAND, this could translate into more margin challenges, they add.(jiahui.huang@wsj.com; @ivy_jiahuihuang)
